caption:
✍️ Comma pairs around extra info

✅ Rule: Nonessential info is wrapped in a pair of commas.
❌ My brother, a pilot flies to Denver often.
✅ My brother, a pilot, flies to Denver often.
✅ Quick check: Delete the extra info. The sentence should still work.
